en_meaning: To polish something, especially metal, by rubbing to make it shiny; to enhance or improve one's image
vi_meaning: Đánh bóng, mài giũa để làm sáng bóng
example_sentence: Seeking to burnish his diplomatic legacy before the upcoming summit, the veteran statesman mediated a delicate ceasefire between the long-warring border nations.

en_meaning: Moving or tending to move away from a center; tending to disperse
vi_meaning: Ly tâm, có xu hướng văng ra xa tâm
example_sentence: As the empire expanded across disparate continents, centrifugal political forces gradually eroded the central government's authority, hastening its eventual dissolution.

en_meaning: To move in an energetic, noisy, or hurried manner; busy activity
vi_meaning: Hối hả, rộn ràng, nhộn nhịp di chuyển
example_sentence: Merchant vessels and couriers continued to bustle through the Venetian harbor at dawn, transforming the tranquil lagoon into a labyrinth of maritime commerce.

en_meaning: A source of defense or support; to strengthen or reinforce
vi_meaning: Củng cố, chống đỡ, làm tăng sức thuyết phục
example_sentence: To buttress her controversial thesis on institutional inequality, the sociologist marshaled decades of longitudinal census data and archival records.

en_meaning: (Of a woman) healthily plump, full-bosomed, and attractive
vi_meaning: Đầy đặn, nở nang, tràn đầy sức sống
example_sentence: Eighteenth-century Dutch portraiture frequently depicted buxom peasant women against harvest landscapes, celebrating pastoral vitality and abundance.

en_meaning: A small group of people who plan secret plots or schemes
vi_meaning: Băng đảng phe phái mưu đồ bí mật
example_sentence: Suspecting that a palace cabal was covertly orchestrating a coup, the emperor dismissed his most senior ministers and placed the royal guard on high alert.

en_meaning: A collection of items stored in a hidden or inaccessible place
vi_meaning: Nơi cất giấu bí mật, kho cất trữ
example_sentence: Archaeologists excavating the cliffside cave discovered a clandestine cache of bronze weapons and minted coins dating back to the late Hellenistic period.

en_meaning: Involving or producing a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds
vi_meaning: Chói tai, hỗn tạp, khó nghe
example_sentence: The pastoral stillness of the valley was suddenly shattered by the cacophonous roar of industrial steam engines and shrieking iron whistles.

en_meaning: A dead human body, especially one intended for medical dissection or research
vi_meaning: Tử thi, thi hài dùng cho giải phẫu
example_sentence: During the Renaissance, anatomists like Vesalius challenged scholastic dogma by meticulously dissecting a human cadaver to observe anatomical structures firsthand.

en_meaning: Resembling a corpse in being pale, emaciated, or gaunt
vi_meaning: Tái mét như tử thi, gầy gò hốc hác
example_sentence: Years of solitary confinement and malnutrition had rendered the political dissident cadaverous, with hollowed cheeks and a paper-thin complexion.

en_meaning: A rhythmic sequence or flow of sounds in language or music
vi_meaning: Nhịp điệu, ngữ điệu nhịp nhàng
example_sentence: The orator captivated the assembly not merely with forceful arguments, but with the musical cadence and rhetorical pauses of his delivery.

en_meaning: To persuade someone to do something by sustained coaxing or flattery
vi_meaning: Dụ dỗ, nịnh hót để thuyết phục
example_sentence: Despite their persistent efforts to cajole the obstinate senator with promises of committee appointments, party leaders failed to secure his decisive vote.

en_meaning: An event causing great and often sudden damage or distress; a disaster
vi_meaning: Tai họa, đại họa thảm khốc
example_sentence: The sudden collapse of the national banking system precipitated an economic calamity that drove thousands of agrarian families into insolvency.

en_meaning: Done with full awareness of the likely consequences; intentional and deliberate
vi_meaning: Được tính toán kỹ lưỡng, có chủ đích
example_sentence: The general’s retreat was not a panic-stricken rout, but a calculated tactical maneuver designed to draw the enemy forces deeper into inhospitable terrain.

en_meaning: A large metal pot used for boiling; a situation characterized by intense emotional turmoil
vi_meaning: Vạc lớn, nơi sục sôi xung đột
example_sentence: By the summer of 1914, the Balkans had transformed into a geopolitical caldron of ethnic rivalry and imperial ambition awaiting a single spark.

en_meaning: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; internal diameter
vi_meaning: Phẩm chất, năng lực, tầm cỡ
example_sentence: Attracting scholars of extraordinary caliber, the nascent research institute quickly established itself as a preeminent hub for quantum physics.

en_meaning: The art of producing decorative and elegant handwriting or lettering
vi_meaning: Nghệ thuật thư pháp
example_sentence: In imperial China, mastery of calligraphy was regarded not merely as a decorative craft, but as a profound reflection of a scholar-official’s moral discipline.

en_meaning: Showing or having a cruel and coldhearted disregard for others
vi_meaning: Nhẫn tâm, vô cảm, chai sạn
example_sentence: The tenement landlord exhibited a callous indifference to the tenants' plight, refusing to restore heating during the harshest weeks of winter.

en_meaning: Inexperienced and immature, especially of a young person
vi_meaning: Non nớt, thiếu kinh nghiệm, chưa trưởng thành
example_sentence: Entrusted with a command far beyond his capabilities, the callow subaltern struggled to maintain order among battle-hardened veteran soldiers.

en_meaning: Relating to or producing heat or dietary calories
vi_meaning: Sinh nhiệt, tạo năng lượng nhiệt
example_sentence: Anthropologists argue that the culinary transition to cooked meat increased the calorific efficiency of early hominin diets, fueling rapid brain development.

en_meaning: The making of false and defamatory statements to damage someone's reputation; slander
vi_meaning: Sự vu khống, lời phỉ báng bôi nhọ
example_sentence: Rather than addressing his opponent's policy platform on its merits, the candidate resorted to malicious calumny in an attempt to tarnish her integrity.

en_meaning: Mutual trust and warm friendship among people who spend a lot of time together
vi_meaning: Tình bạn đồng đội, sự gắn bó thân thiết
example_sentence: Enduring grueling arctic blizzards and isolation, the explorers forged a deep sense of camaraderie that sustained them throughout the harrowing expedition.

en_meaning: A brief appearance or role by a prominent person; a carving in relief on a gem
vi_meaning: Vai diễn khách mời, hình chạm nổi nghệ thuật
example_sentence: The celebrated director made an unexpected cameo as a bystander in the film's climactic railway station scene, delighting astute cinephiles.

en_meaning: Disguising personnel, equipment, or machinery by making them blend with the surroundings
vi_meaning: Sự ngụy trang, tài ngụy trang
example_sentence: The mottled plumage of the ptarmigan provides indispensable camouflage against the snowy tundra, shielding it from aerial raptors.

en_meaning: The quality of being open, honest, and sincere in expression; forthrightness
vi_meaning: Sự bộc trực, tính ngay thẳng thật thà
example_sentence: The auditor was widely respected for her unvarnished candor, never hesitating to expose accounting discrepancies regardless of executive pushback.

en_meaning: Relating to or resembling dogs or members of the dog family
vi_meaning: Thuộc loài chó, có đặc tính như loài chó
example_sentence: Paleontologists reconstructed the prehistoric predator's lineage by comparing its prominent canine dentition with that of modern wolves.

en_meaning: Having or showing shrewdness and good judgment, especially in money or business
vi_meaning: Khôn ngoan, sắc sảo, tính toán thận trọng
example_sentence: Through canny negotiations and well-timed acquisitions during economic recessions, the industrialist built an unparalleled manufacturing empire.

en_meaning: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without undergoing permanent chemical change; an agent of change
vi_meaning: Chất xúc tác, nhân tố thúc đẩy biến đổi
example_sentence: The publication of Thomas Paine’s 'Common Sense' acted as a powerful catalyst, galvanizing widespread colonial sentiment in favor of outright independence.

en_meaning: Hypocritical and sanctimonious talk, typically of a moral, religious, or political nature
vi_meaning: Lời nói đạo đức giả, giáo điều sáo rỗng
example_sentence: Weary of the sanctimonious cant spouted by career politicians, voters gravitated toward independent candidates promising uncompromising transparency.

en_meaning: Bad-tempered, argumentative, and uncooperative
vi_meaning: Gắt gỏng, khó tính, ngang ngạnh
example_sentence: Known for his cantankerous temperament, the reclusive composer frequently feuded with concert hall managers and rebuffed interview requests.

en_meaning: A medium-length narrative piece of music for voices with instrumental accompaniment
vi_meaning: Bản hợp xướng cantata
example_sentence: Johann Sebastian Bach composed a solemn sacred cantata for each Sunday of the liturgical calendar, weaving intricate choral polyphony with biblical texts.

en_meaning: A three-beat gait of a horse between a trot and a gallop; to move at such a pace
vi_meaning: Nước kiệu nhỏ, bước phi thong thả của ngựa
example_sentence: Reining in the spirited thoroughbred to a steady canter, the equestrian negotiated the winding forest trail with effortless grace.

en_meaning: A major division or section of a long narrative poem
vi_meaning: Khúc ca, khổ thơ lớn trong trường ca
example_sentence: In the culminating canto of the 'Inferno', Dante and Virgil navigate the frozen ninth circle of hell before ascending to glimpse the stars once more.

en_meaning: To solicit votes, orders, or opinions from a group; to examine thoroughly
vi_meaning: Vận động bầu cử, khảo sát ý kiến quần chúng
example_sentence: Grassroots organizers mobilized hundreds of volunteers to canvass residential districts door-to-door ahead of the crucial municipal referendum.

en_meaning: Having a lot of space inside; roomy and expansive
vi_meaning: Rộng lớn, có sức chứa bao la
example_sentence: The university’s newly constructed archive featured capacious reading rooms designed to store centuries of fragile parchment manuscripts safely.

en_meaning: To cease resisting an opponent or an unwelcome demand; to surrender under specified terms
vi_meaning: Đầu hàng, chịu khuất phục
example_sentence: Besieged for months without fresh provisions or ammunition, the garrison commander was finally compelled to capitulate to avoid the starvation of his troops.

en_meaning: A sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior; whim
vi_meaning: Tính khí thất thường, ý thích bất chợt
example_sentence: Living under absolute monarchy meant that the liberties and fortunes of subjects were perpetually subject to the monarch’s arbitrary caprice.

en_meaning: Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behavior; erratic and unpredictable
vi_meaning: Thất thường, bất thường khó đoán
example_sentence: Alpine meteorologists cautioned climbers that capricious mountain winds could instantly transform clear skies into a blinding blizzard.

en_meaning: A title or brief explanation accompanying an illustration, photograph, or document
vi_meaning: Lời chú thích dưới hình ảnh, phụ đề
example_sentence: The historical photograph’s brief caption shed light on the obscure identity of the abolitionist standing beside Frederick Douglass.

en_meaning: To attract and hold the interest and attention of; to enchant or fascinate
vi_meaning: Thu hút, làm mê hoặc, làm say đắm
example_sentence: The prima ballerina continued to captivate audiences worldwide with her expressive interpretations of classical repertoire and fluid athleticism.

en_meaning: A unit of weight for precious stones and pearls, equivalent to 200 milligrams; a measure of purity for gold
vi_meaning: Cara (đơn vị đo trọng lượng đá quý hoặc độ tinh khiết của vàng)
example_sentence: Gemologists determined that the sapphire’s astronomical auction value was due not only to its flawless clarity, but to its rare twelve-carat mass.

en_meaning: Of the greatest importance; fundamental or primary
vi_meaning: Cốt yếu, căn bản, quan trọng bậc nhất
example_sentence: In investigative journalism, verifying source corroboration before publishing unverified leaks is considered a cardinal rule of professional ethics.

en_meaning: A medical doctor who specializes in the study, diagnosis, and treatment of heart disorders
vi_meaning: Bác sĩ chuyên khoa tim mạch
example_sentence: After analyzing the patient’s irregular electrocardiogram readings, the cardiologist recommended immediate surgical intervention to relieve arterial blockage.

en_meaning: To tilt, lean over, or swerve violently while moving rapidly
vi_meaning: Nghiêng ngả, lao chao đảo mất kiểm soát
example_sentence: Losing traction on the slick mountain road, the heavy freight truck began to careen precariously toward the precipitous guardrail.

en_meaning: A representation of a person or thing in which certain features are exaggerated for comic or grotesque effect
vi_meaning: Tranh biếm họa, hình tượng châm biếm bóp méo
example_sentence: Political cartoonists of the Gilded Age often drew industrial monopolists as bloated, rapacious caricatures draped in bags of currency.

en_meaning: The slaughter or killing of a large number of people, as in battle
vi_meaning: Cảnh tàn sát đẫm máu, sự thảm sát
example_sentence: Surveying the horrific carnage left on the battlefield after the artillery barrage, the young officer questioned the moral justification of the campaign.

en_meaning: Relating to physical, bodily, especially sexual appetites or desires rather than the spiritual
vi_meaning: Thuộc về xác thịt, nhục dục trần tục
example_sentence: Medieval ascetic philosophers urged monks to transcend transient carnal desires in pursuit of enduring spiritual enlightenment.

en_meaning: (Of an animal) feeding on the flesh of other animals; (of a plant) consuming insects
vi_meaning: Ăn thịt, ăn côn trùng (thực vật)
example_sentence: In nutrient-deficient bogs, carnivorous plants such as the pitcher plant have evolved specialized traps to capture insects and supplement their nitrogen intake.

en_meaning: Difficult to please; constantly finding fault in a petty and nagging way
vi_meaning: Hay soi mói, hay bắt bẻ vặt vãnh
example_sentence: Despite the unanimous critical acclaim garnered by the symphony, a few carping reviewers focused solely on negligible tempo fluctuations during the finale.

en_meaning: A specialist who compiles, draws, or produces geographical maps and charts
vi_meaning: Nhà vẽ bản đồ, chuyên gia địa đồ
example_sentence: Employing newly refined sextants and celestial observations, the sixteenth-century cartographer drafted remarkably precise navigational charts of the Atlantic.
